description: Source code for environmental effects and triggers in the Unvanquished game, including push, teleport, hurt, gravity, heal, and ammo triggers.

methods.name: InitEnvAFXEntity
methods.description: Initializes environmental effect entities, setting model, contents, and linking if specified.

methods.name: env_afx_toggle
methods.description: Toggles linking state of the entity.

methods.name: SP_env_afx_push
methods.description: Sets up a push trigger entity.

methods.name: env_afx_push_touch
methods.description: Handles touch event for push trigger, applying velocity to activator.

methods.name: SP_env_afx_teleport
methods.description: Sets up a teleport trigger entity.

methods.name: env_afx_teleporter_touch
methods.description: Handles teleportation when an entity touches the teleporter.

methods.name: env_afx_teleporter_act
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the teleporter.

methods.name: SP_env_afx_hurt
methods.description: Sets up a hurt trigger entity.

methods.name: env_afx_hurt_touch
methods.description: Applies damage and sound when an entity touches the hurt trigger.

methods.name: SP_env_afx_gravity
methods.description: Sets up a gravity modification trigger.

methods.name: env_afx_gravity_touch
methods.description: Applies gravity change to touching client.

methods.name: SP_env_afx_ammo
methods.description: Sets up an ammo refill trigger.

methods.name: env_afx_ammo_touch
methods.description: Refills ammo for the touching client.
